text:
Ellen (Marketing): New draft in drive — quick pass pls. Need: hero copy, benchmark phrasing, webinar slot, and inbound lead tags. https://docs.google.com/d/launch-brief

Kai (Content): On it. Suggest we avoid hype words. Keep hero factual and scannable.

Jordan (Growth): Bench data summary: median 1.75x cost reduction across 4 customers; peak case ~2x. What do we call it on hero?

Ellen (Marketing): Hero proposal: 'Up to 2x lower inference cost at production scale' — include footnote to methods.

Rhea (Legal): Change to sentence case: 'Up to 2x lower inference cost'. Add footnote with link to methodology and short disclaimer: 'Results vary; see methodology.'

Kai (Content): Updating hero + meta description. I'll add parenthetical link to methodology in the appendix. Also writing short social variants without absolutes.

Sam (Events): Webinar: can we do June 12 at 10am PT (30 min)? Need presenter and deck. Registration cap 300.

Jordan (Growth): I can present routing demo. June 12 works. Will keep demo 12 min + Q&A.

notify-bot: Event created — "Optimize: Launch Demo" June 12 10:00 PT.

Luis (Ops): HubSpot UTM plan: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=optimize_launch_jun2026. Map to list_id=775544. Form fields: company_size, primary_use_case, region. Will set automation to tag leads optimize_launch_jun2026 and route to SDR queue.

Ellen (Marketing): Paste UTM example into post so CTAs are consistent. Kai please swap primary CTA to 'Register for demo' and secondary to 'Request a dedicated trial'.

Kai (Content): Done. CTAs updated and social copy variants added. Flagged two customer quotes for approval (highlighted).

Rhea (Legal): Customer attributions require written signoff. Please mark quotes pending approval and include email template. Also removed any superlatives from social.

Luis (Ops): I'll confirm automation when live. ETA 12 hours.

Sam (Events): Sent invites; rehearsal June 11 2pm PT. Will pin deck once Kai uploads.

Jordan (Growth): Uploaded slides and quick runbook.

Luis (Ops): Automation live and routing confirmed to SDR queue. list_id=775544.

Ellen (Marketing): Publish target June 10 8am PT. Final checklist: legal done, quotes approved/flagged, hubspot live, deck attached. React with :white_check_mark: when ready.

Kai (Content): :white_check_mark: one quote pending, highlighted and outreach sent.

Rhea (Legal): :white_check_mark: edits complete.

Jordan (Growth): :white_check_mark: slides up.

Luis (Ops): :white_check_mark: automation live.

Sam (Events): :white_check_mark: rehearsal scheduled.

Ellen (Marketing): Thanks team — I'll schedule publish and monitor the registrant flow. If quote doesn't clear, we'll anonymize. Closing thread.
